title: Karte raho matam pyaaso ka
body:
MAQTAL MEIN YE THI ZEHRA KI SADA, BE GOR-O-KAFAN LAASHA HAI TERA, HAYE HUSSAIN HAYE HUSSAIN
HAI ARZOO EK ZEHRA KI YEHI, PARWA NAHI DUNIYA KI KOI, SHABBIR KE GHAM MEIN HONA KAMI, BEH JAYE LAHOO GAR IS DIL KA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
YE KARBO BALA WALO KA HAI GHAM, HAR EK IBADAT SE HAI AHAAM, HO GHAM MEIN INHI KE ANKHEN NAAM, JINE KA HAI MAQSAD BUS ITNA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
AB RAN KO CHALE ZAINAB KE PISAR, HONE KO FIDA WO MAMOO PAR, DARIYA KI TARAF JO KI NA NAZAR, LAASHO PA WO MADAR KA SAJDA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
<<DIVIDER>>
NAUSHAHA BANA THA IBNE HAASAN, PAMAAL HUA GHODO SE BADAN, BEWA HUI LAMHO KI DULHAN, SHAADI KI JAGA MATAM THA BAPA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
SIN IBNE HASSAN KA TERA BARAS, BARIK SA KURTA TAN MEINTHA BAS, DAM LENE NA PAYA EK NAFAS, WO LAAKHO SITAMGAR YE TANHA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
HAI EK TARAYI PAR LAASHA, BE DAST BADAN ZAKHMO SE SAJA, PARDE KA MUHAFIZ AUR SAQQA, DARIYA KE KINARA QATL HUA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA, PHAL BARCHI KHAYE JO AKBAR, DEKHE YE SAMAAN KAISE SARWAR, KIS TARHA UTHATE LAASHE PISAR, HAR GAAM YE THI SARWAR KI BUKA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
BANO KA WO BACCHA NHANNA SA, THA TEEN DINO KA JO PYAASA, KYA TEER KE QABIL YE SIN THA, JO TEER SE CHEDA USKA GALA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
<<DIVIDER>>
THA SHAAME GHAREEBA KA JO SAMAAN, KHAIMO SE FAQAT UTH TA THA DHUWA, MASOOM SI JAAN KARTI THI FUGHAAN, KEHTI THI MADAD KO AOO CHACHA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
DURRO KI JAFA ABID KA BADAN, ZAKHMO SE AAYA KANTO KI CHUBAN, WO TOUQE GARAAN ZAKHMI GARDAN, KYA SABR THA IBNE SARWAR KA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
ZINDAAN MEIN SAKINA KI THI FUGHAAN, GHOOTTA HAIN YAHA DAM AYE AMMA, BATLAO MERE BABA HAIN KAHA, DUSHWAR HUA MERA JINA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASOKA
AAYI HAI BAHEN CHEHLUM KE LIYE, ISS TARHA LAHAD PAR BHAYI KE, RASSI KE NASHAAN SHAANO PA LIYE, KEHTI THI SUNAO MAIN KYA KYA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
<<DIVIDER>>
JAB APNE WATAN POUNCHA KUNBA, SAJJAD KA PAIHAM GIRYA THA, YOON GHAM MEIN MADINA DOOBA THA, HAR GHAR MEIN FAQAT THI AAHO BUKA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
NANA KI LAHAD PAR BINTE ALI, FARYAAD O FUGHAANYE KARTI THI, AYE NANA UTHO ZAINAB AAYI, LE AAYI HOON MAIN UMMAT KA SILA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASOKA
AAYI HAI WAHAANI BEKAS SUHGRA, AUR HAAL PHOOPI SE SAB KA SUNA, HAR BIBI KI GODI MEIN DEKHA, ASGHAR BHI NAHIN WAPIS LOUTA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
PARWANE QASIM HAR LAMHA SADA, MATAM KARTE AAYE HAIN TERA, BULWA LO INHE AB KARBO BALA, WAAN LAB PAR RAHE BAS YE NOUHA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
<<DIVIDER>>
SAR PEETO SOHAIL QASTA JIGAR, MAADAR KI LAHAD PAR RAKH KAR SAR, KEHTI HAI YE ZAINAB RORO KAR, SOUGAAT MAIN LAAYI HOON KURTA
KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA
WO DEKHO SOHAIL QASTA JIGAR, LASHE PE BEHAN AAYI HAI MAGAR, CHADAR NAHI SER PER HAAL DIGAR, KEHTI THI CHALE AAO BHAIYA, KARTE RAHO MATAM PYAASO KA..
